lines.zh: 我一弹一弹地贴着地走。
lines.en: I bounce along flat over the ground.

lines.zh: 我这一身胶质，走起来会晃。
lines.en: This gelatinous body of mine sloshes as I move.

lines.zh: 地面被我一压，凹了下去。
lines.en: The ground dips under my weight.

lines.zh: 我滚一段，再把自己撑起来。
lines.en: I roll a stretch, then push myself up.
I drag a trail of slime behind me.
My body glows green in the light.

lines.zh: 顺着斜坡，我整摊淌下去。
lines.en: I pour down the slope whole.

lines.zh: 我压过一片草，草都贴地了。
lines.en: I roll over grass and it lies flat.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝有声音的地方去。
lines.en: I head slowly toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我的边被石块磕了一下。
lines.en: A stone nicked my edge.

lines.zh: 我把散出去的一点收回来。
lines.en: I pull a bit of myself back in.
I wobble my way over.
I slump there, quivering faintly.
This gel body rises and falls.
Something turns over inside me.
I cool slowly in the shade.
I swallow a small stone.
My edges are tacky.
I'm listening to the ground's tremors.
I stay still, like a puddle.

lines.zh: 阳光从我这身里透下去。
lines.en: Sunlight filters down through me.
A layer swells on my surface.

lines.zh: 我身体里的小东西在动。
lines.en: The small things inside me are moving.

lines.zh: 我顺着地面摊成一整片。
lines.en: I spread flat across the ground.
I have no bones, and falls mean little.
I lie spread out, waiting for something to step in.
You're an inch from my edge.

lines.zh: 我身体里装了很多东西。
lines.en: I'm carrying a great deal inside me.

lines.zh: 你看我这一身，能装下你。
lines.en: Looking at this body — it could hold you.
I'm wider than you, and heavier.
Would you like to touch it?
My edge keeps sticking to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一摊缓缓朝你转了向。
lines.en: This mass turns slowly your way.
You've stepped in my trail.

lines.zh: 我的颜色和这片草不一样。
lines.en: My color doesn't match this grass.
I'm deciding whether to move.
Don't stand at my lower side.
Listen; something's moving inside me.
I am much wider than you are.
My edge is slowly spreading wider.
Do not underestimate this puddle.
I am slowly closing around you.
Grass sticks in this body of mine.
Where you stand is too low ground.
A piece of me was knocked off.
My body has spread out flat.
I slowly gather back together.
I don't much mind this wound.
There's my slime all over the floor.
I quiver and my edges ripple.
I've gotten a little smaller.
Everything inside me is churning.
Another small piece splits off.
I'll grow it back.
I don't eat things; I wrap them.
Why do you keep holding it up?
Small enough to swallow in one wrap.
I'm not that kind of monster.
Put that thing away quickly.
It would sink in at my edge.
I've had more than enough of such things.
You'd better keep it.
I'm coming closer; don't move.
It smells rather good.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞进一摊泥。
lines.en: You hit me like hitting a puddle of mud.
You've sunk in a little.
I slowly push you back out.
My edge closes over your boot tip.
You pull away, leaving a wet patch.
You've squashed me out of shape.
You hit me and I don't even change shape.
A small piece split off me.
It hops about on the floor.
I take it back in.
There's kin inside my body already.
They grow inside me.
I don't need to find anyone.
I'll slowly send them out.
They're moving, impatiently.
I'm a crowd all by myself.
I've been like this a long while.
My body grows heavier.
Sooner or later they'll leave.

lines.zh: 总有一天，我会散成许多个。
lines.en: One day I'll split into many.

lines.zh: 我合上边，把它闷在里头。
lines.en: My edge closes and seals it in.
It dissolves slowly in there.
It sticks to me at a touch.
I keep it inside my body.
It's too hard; give it time.
I press it down so it won't roll.
That's not worth the trouble.
My edge squeezes the thing aside.
It sinks down inside me.
I spat it back out.
Footsteps are trembling through the ground to me.
I shift toward that sound.
My edge gets there first.

lines.zh: 你的影儿压着我这一摊。
lines.en: Your shadow presses down on this mass of me.

lines.zh: 再跨一步，我就压上去了。
lines.en: One more stride and I press down on you.
I'm not fast, but I'm large.
You've climbed up onto a stone.
I'm pressing in slowly.
I'm starting to move now.
If you're running, be quick about it.
This body of mine can block a path.
There's nothing else around you.
The floor is shaking with me.
You're square in front of me. Good.
When I get there, I'll wrap around you.
This day has been long in coming.
Here we go again.
Then no more waiting. Begin.
I keep shifting toward you.
You take a step; I roll a short stretch.

lines.zh: 我留下的一道湿痕在跟着你。
lines.en: The wet trail I leave follows you.
The more you back off, the wider I spread.
I'm waiting for you to come near my edge.
The things inside me are moving faster.
I have no need to draw breath.
I come around from your flank.

lines.zh: 你的鞋上还沾着我的黏液。
lines.en: There's still my slime on your boots.
I stretch my body out long.
You've been backed into the corner.
I come slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 这一带没有高地方给你。
lines.en: There's no high ground for you here.

lines.zh: 你的心跳传到我这里很闷。
lines.en: Your heartbeat reaches me muffled.
Slime is running from my edges.
This puddle is never in a hurry.
You're already losing your head.
My edge is nearly on you.

lines.zh: 我贴到地面上，摊得更薄。
lines.en: I press to the ground and spread thinner.
I stop at exactly this distance.

lines.zh: 我一下子扑过去，把你裹住。
lines.en: I lunge and wrap myself around you.
You're stuck inside my body.
My edge has tightened.
You kick wildly inside me.
A small piece of me splits off again.

lines.zh: 这一下你身上全是黏液。
lines.en: Now you're covered in slime.
I'm slow, but I'm heavy.
A thread of me tears away as you pull back.

lines.zh: 我慢慢聚回原来的形状。
lines.en: I slowly gather back into shape.
You can't catch your breath inside me.
I add another layer and press harder.
You slip from the shove.
This soft mass doesn't hit hard.
Part of my body has spread out.
You are actually still moving.
I slowly spit you back out.
I swell up out of a crack in the soil.

lines.zh: 地上一摊绿色开始动了。
lines.en: A puddle of green on the floor starts to move.
My edge takes shape bit by bit.
The ground is soft here. Perfect.
First I spread myself out.

lines.zh: 我听见这块地方的动静。
lines.en: I take in the sounds of this place.
I rise a little.

lines.zh: 我身体里的东西都醒着。
lines.en: Everything inside me is awake.

lines.zh: 我来的时候没有人看到。
lines.en: Nobody saw me arrive.
This ground is mine now.

lines.zh: 我留下一道长长的湿印。
lines.en: I leave a long wet trail.
I start moving forward.
The damp is heavy around here.
I squeeze slowly up out of the soil.

lines.zh: 我的第一件事是铺开身体。
lines.en: The first thing I do is spread out.
I listen while I take shape.

lines.zh: 地上多了一层薄薄的光。
lines.en: A thin sheen of light appears on the floor.
I am not quite settled yet.
Fire scorches me and my edges pull in.

lines.zh: 从高处坠下，我摊得更宽。
lines.en: I drop from the height and spread wider.

lines.zh: 水一进来，我整个都稀了。
lines.en: Water gets in and I thin out completely.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我炸散了一大片。
lines.en: The blast scatters a big part of me.

lines.zh: 一个东西穿过我，留了个洞。
lines.en: Something punches through me and leaves a hole.
A light makes me stiffen.
Hunger thins me out more and more.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我整摊都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my whole puddle quivers.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有可以裹。
lines.en: There's nothing here to wrap up.
